description: Use this when the user asks how their site does IN GOOGLE SEARCH — queries they rank for, impressions, clicks, CTR, average position. Real Search Console data from their own property, not an estimate. Returns totals plus top queries and top pages. It lags ~2 days, so the newest days are always incomplete — say so rather than reporting a drop. If connected is false, call connect_search_console(app_id) — it returns a consent_url to hand the owner, and that IS the whole setup: the property matching the site's domain is bound automatically as soon as they approve. Do NOT send them hunting through Kleap's settings. If site_selected is false the message names the cause — read it, do not guess: the site has no custom domain (connect_domain first — a {slug}.kleap.io host can never be a Search Console property), or the Google account has no VERIFIED property for that domain yet (add and verify it, then read again — Kleap binds it). For all-source visitors use get_analytics. Requires the analytics:read scope — on INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE the connection has NOT expired: it was authorized before this tool existed and needs one re-authorization to add the scope. Say that, never that it expired.

app_id.description: The app id to fetch search data for

context.description: Why this call, in one short sentence. Used to improve the connector; never include credentials or personal data.

period.description: Time window: '28d' (default, the window Search Console itself shows), '7d', '30d' or '90d'

name: get_search_console
title: Get Google Search Performance
